target: acceptances 2+3+5 — the payload must exist in agents/reviewer.md AND the review stage must route hardened specs to it. Checked structurally: the marker resolves and the hardened branch names the payload's own sections.
cmd: r="$PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/reviewer.md"; s="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"; mark=$(grep -c "profile-hardened-payload:" "$r"); fmt=$(grep -c -- "- boundary: <from> -> <to>" "$r"); abuse=$(grep -c -- "- abuse:" "$r"); tool=$(grep -c "hardened.sh" "$r"); lst=$(grep -c "templates/hardened-classes.txt" "$r"); route=$(grep -c "hardened.sh" "$s"); printf '{"marker":%s,"format":%s,"abuse":%s,"tool":%s,"classList":%s,"routed":%s}' "$mark" "$fmt" "$abuse" "$tool" "$lst" "$route"
